title: Fun, educational and worth it.
text:
This was an experience. Our tour guide for the first half of the tour was Melissa and she was wonderful. Kind, knowledgeable and so funny. 
She was also patient with our teenager. 
She knew everything about everywhere we went. We did a coach tour followed by plaza de España, real alcazar and cathedral. 
If you don’t have much time this first half of the tour is a must. 
For the second half we did a river tour and to be honest you can skip this part but following that is the bullring and you shouldn’t skip on that. Very interesting. 
Over all a tiring day, filled with so much knowledge and cult

title: Seville Highlights
text: The Alcázar Palace and the Seville Cathedral are amazing although the cathedral holds a sinful amount of gold and silver.  We also really enjoyed walking through the Santa Cruz neighborhood.
author: Mary_B

title: A stunning visit
text: Combining a day of sightseeing Alcazar and Cathedral is possible. You will be enchanted by the interior of the cathedral, its many chapels and the Giralda, former minaret from which the view is stunning. 34 bearings to climb.... Less difficult than stairs but still... The Alcazar without reservation takes about thirty minutes to access the cash register. Many people so difficult to take pictures without anyone... Beautiful park and sumptuous palace. 11€50 per person.
author: Nadia B

title: Tour guides: Melissa and Cecilia...
text:
Tour guides: Melissa and Cecilia. Wonderful tour guides, they explains things very well.

Seville has so much history and culture. Buildings we saw are just amazing. Very picturesque, photographers heaven :. Bull fighting area visit was amazing, one of best experience I had on the trip. Seville has so much to offer. I highly recommend this tour.
